title: Lior and the Thorn
author: Kestrel Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Oyelaran, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
